title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 345 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Working hard or hardly fusing? 💫

A broad dark coronal region and several bright EUV active regions stand out today, while the visible disk remains otherwise quiet.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
